research_problem_model.research_title_fa: بررسی اثر هورمون رشد نوترکیب بر ترکیب بدنی و حساسیت به انسولین در کودکان مبتلا به سندرم پرادر-ویلی
research_problem_model.research_title_en: Efficacy of Recombinant Human Growth Hormone on Body Composition and Peripheral Insulin Sensitivity in Pediatric Patients with Prader-Willi Syndrome: A Multicenter Randomized Double-Blind Controlled Trial

target_condition.name_fa: سندرم پرادر-ویلی و چاقی شدید کودکان

population_or_model.primary_system: Pediatric patients aged 4 to 12 years with genetically confirmed Prader-Willi Syndrome

primary_outcomes.name: Change in Lean Body Mass by DEXA Scan
primary_outcomes.measurement_unit: Kilograms lean mass change at 52 weeks

primary_outcomes.name: Homeostatic Model Assessment for Insulin Resistance (HOMA-IR)
preferred_assays: Fasting plasma glucose and insulin immunoassay

hypothesized_mechanisms.pathway_name: IGF-1 / Lipolysis and Protein Anabolism Cascade

studies.title: Long-term randomized trial of growth hormone replacement demonstrates sustained improvement in lean muscle accrual in Prader-Willi syndrome

design_specific_attributes.primary_endpoint_definition: Change in DEXA total lean body mass at 12 months
design_specific_attributes.randomization_allocation: 1:1 computer generated block randomization with central allocation concealment
design_specific_attributes.blinding_procedure: Double-blinded participants, clinicians, and DEXA evaluators

studies.title: Impaired glucose tolerance and transient hyperinsulinemia during high-dose growth hormone therapy in obese syndromes

design_specific_attributes.target_population_criteria: Subgroup analysis of high-BMI children receiving > 1.5 mg/m2/day somatropin

negative_or_null_findings.description: Supra-physiological dosing elevated fasting HOMA-IR significantly requiring protocol-mandated dose titrations.
